lifecycle.activation_contract: Manifest 0.3 activation is owned by vLLM-HUST Extension Manager/ECPA. StateAxis accepts only version 0.2.0 with the pinned research-manifest hash and reviewed generation-bound delta policy; the host implementation adaptively coalesces multi-row or multi-range H2D updates.
lifecycle.rollback_contract: Disable or forget the extension. StateAxis then uploads the full decode block table and slot vector on every batch.

supported_workloads: decode batches with stable row/state generation identity, per-step slot updates and infrequent block-table growth
out_of_scope: automatic inheritance from StateAxis aggregate evidence

performance_claims.label: real-npu-component-bytes-positive-online-unqualified
performance_claims.result: Control and candidate device snapshots matched exactly; the tested update transferred 36 control bytes versus 12 candidate bytes. This is component byte-reduction evidence, not online serving performance evidence.

performance_claims.label: component-npu-matched-adaptive-positive-online-unqualified
performance_claims.scope: Ascend 910B2 metadata preparation plus synchronized H2D, 32 blocks per row, decode-128 cycle, B1/B8/B32
performance_claims.result: Exact snapshots on two devices. Adaptive candidate median speedups were 1.92x/1.88x/1.85x on device 0 and 1.91x/1.87x/1.86x on device 1. Row-sparse B8/B32 negatives are retained. This is component evidence and does not claim online request throughput.
